purpose: The highlight package creates spring-animated Roblox `Highlight` instances on the client. `HighlightServiceClient` is the normal entry point: it shares one `AnimatedHighlightGroup`, stacks competing highlight requests per adornee, and shows the request with the highest score.
description: The highlight package creates spring-animated Roblox `Highlight` instances on the client. `HighlightServiceClient` is the normal entry point: it shares one `AnimatedHighlightGroup`, stacks competing highlight requests per adornee, and shows the request with the highest score.

Client/HighlightServiceClient.luau.description: Centralized group Public entry points include `HighlightServiceClient.Init`, `HighlightServiceClient.GetAnimatedHighlightGroup`, `HighlightServiceClient.Highlight`, `HighlightServiceClient.Destroy`.

Client/Stack/AnimatedHighlight.luau.description: Animated Highlight provides the class/model implementation used by the Highlight package. Public entry points include `AnimatedHighlight.new`, `AnimatedHighlight.isAnimatedHighlight`, `AnimatedHighlight.SetHighlightDepthMode`, `AnimatedHighlight.SetPropertiesFrom`, `transferSpringValue`, `AnimatedHighlight.SetTransparencySpeed`, `AnimatedHighlight.SetColorSpeed`, `AnimatedHighlight.SetSpeed`.
